Class IuJsonbNaming

java.lang.Object
iu.client.jsonb.IuJsonbNaming
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyNaming
final class IuJsonbNaming extends Object implements PropertyNaming
How a call names properties in JSON: by an IU property name format, which a IuJsonAdapter.SERIALIZATION_OPTIONS supplier may change from call to call, or by a JSON-B PropertyNamingStrategy fixed for the provider.
